content: Thotho gheghad
Loi vambe i renuwaŋakiki vara Nowa na thetheghanɨma wolaghɨye, mbwanjam na mbwaeva, weiyaŋgi e waŋgako tɨne. Iwaeŋge i variya ndewendewe na i rowa, ko ambama thothoma i njoghanjogha.
Mbwake wolaghɨye rɨghenji e yambaneke raberabe na mbwa e buruburu kaero thɨ vorutowo na uye tembe i uye towova
na thothoko kaero i njoghanjogha na tembe i wova mbaŋa mbaŋathaŋarɨ na mbaŋaelima,
na manjala umbopirɨ ghe mbaŋa mbaŋayaworo na mbaŋapirɨ e tɨne, waŋgama i rovala e ouou idanji Ararat regha vwatae.
Mbwama mbema le didinja eŋge gheghada manjala hoyaworoninji e tɨne. Mbaŋa i viva e tɨne ouou vwatavwatanji kaero thɨ yomara.
Mbaŋa mbaŋaevarɨ e ghereiye Nowa i vugha dedele va i vakatha e waŋgako
na i variye waluwo manda. Vambema i yoyololoŋga eŋge gheghada mbwama i ma moli.
Amba i variye bunebune manda na i wa ve thuwe thoŋgo kaero thelauko i mwa.

Ko kaiwae mbwa vamba i wovululu vara thelauko, bunebunema maava i ndevaidi mun le ghamba yovaro, iya kaiwae vama i yonjoghava weya Nowa e waŋgako. I tagavamomoya nɨmae, i wo bunebunema na i woruwo e waŋgako tɨne.
Nowa i roroghagha mbaŋa theghepirɨ e ghereiye na mbowo i variyeva bunebunema.
Mbaŋa kaero yeghɨyeghɨyenja bunebunema i livutha olivɨ ndamwae amba i tagavwara eŋge. Nowa i ghareghare thelau kaero i mwa.
Mbowo i roroghaghava mbaŋa theghepirɨ e ghereiye, na mbowo i variyeva bunebunema, ko iyemaeŋge ande vama i yonjogha weya Nowa.

Mbaŋa Nowa ghatheghathegha kaero i wo hweseriyewona na umbwara (601), mbaŋaniye manjala i viva ghe mbaŋako regha Nowa i rakayathu waŋgako vwatae, na i thuwe i mena i ghawoko, na iŋa, “Ko thelau kaero i mwa iyako!”
Va manjala umboiwoninji ghe mbaŋa theiwo na theghepirɨ e tɨne yambaneke vambema i mwavao vara.
Amba Loi i dage weya Nowa iŋa,
“Ko ghen na len wevo na le ŋgaŋga na lenji ovo, hu rakaraŋgima e waŋgana tɨne.
Hu bigi raŋgiyaŋgima thetheghanɨna wolaghɨye na maaŋgina, mbalama thɨ ghambɨva togha na thɨ riyevanjara yambaneke laghɨye.”
Kaero Nowa i raŋgi e waŋgama weiyaŋgiya levo, le ŋgaŋga na lenji ovo.

Thetheghaŋgima wolaghɨye na maaŋgima thɨ rakaraŋgi e waŋgama, thegheiwo iya na tomethi ghanjiyamoyamo. Thetheghanɨke wolaghɨye iya thɨ loŋgaloŋga e yambaneke vwatae na maake wolaghɨye — tomethi e lenji wabwi na e ghanjiyamoyamoko thɨ rakarakaraŋgi.
Nowa le vowo
Amba Nowa i vatada ghamba vowo Giya Loi kaiwae. I mbanɨŋgiya thetheghan na maa regha iya e wabwi regha na regha e tɨnenji, iya lenji kururu i vatomwe thɨ thovuye, na i ŋambuŋgi e ghamba vowoko.

Giya Loi i warari butiyeko thovuye kaiwae na e ghareko iŋa, “Maa tene mbaŋa reghava ya vakowana yambaneke lolo le tharɨ kaiwae. Ya ghareghare lolo le renuwaŋa i tharɨ ghe mbaŋa ŋgama na i ghaoko. Ma tene mbaŋa reghava ya vakowanaŋgiya thetheghan e yawayawalinji ŋgoreiya mendava ya vakathako.

content.text: Yambaneke mbene ŋgora vara iyake na i ghaoko,
mbaŋake wolaghɨye ne ghanɨŋga ghakabu ghe mbaŋa na ghalolo ghe mbaŋa,
ne njighɨnjighɨ ghe mbaŋa na meme ghe mbaŋa,
ne varae i ndeghathɨ na uye ghe mbaŋa
